headline: UAL Fortitude sets sail for Brazil with the first commercial export from the Puerto Norte Matamoros
summary: The vessel UAL Fortitude is sailing to Brazil carrying the first commercial export from the Puerto Norte Matamoros port, which the state governor says will support regional logistics.
why: Port expansions in northern Mexico support trade flows and nearshoring activity between the Americas and industrial supply chains.
original_headline: UAL Fortitude zarpa rumbo a Brasil con la primera exportación comercial del Puerto Norte Matamoros
